attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Hawaii state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in HI (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true and apportionment.state_code is equal to "HI"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "HI" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true and apportionment.state_code is equal to "HI"
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "HI" streq } over if

action_details.action_dsl: Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500
action_details.action_postfix: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required; Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions
action_details.action_postfix: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

policy_statement.policy_description: Hawaii filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Hawaii filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). Reference: Hawaii Department of Taxation Form N-30 Instructions, HI Rev. Stat. § 235-1 et seq. (Corporate Income Tax)"

policy_statement.policy_description: Hawaii filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Hawaii filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts OR 200 transactions. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), Hawaii Department of Taxation Economic Nexus Guidance"

policy_statement.policy_description: No Hawaii nexus - no filing requirement.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No Hawaii nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded."

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Hawaii state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate HI state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments

policy_statement.policy_description: Hawaii state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Hawaii state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback, State-specific modifications per Hawaii tax law. Subtractions may include: Hawaii net operating loss deduction, Interest on Hawaii and other municipal bonds. Reference: Hawaii Department of Taxation Form N-30 Instructions, HI Rev. Stat. § 235-7 (Adjustments to Federal Taxable Income)"

policy_statement.policy_description: No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Hawaii state corporate income tax. Applies 6.4% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus is equal to true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is equal to true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive state taxable income; apportionment.state_taxable_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Hawaii 6.4% flat rate calculation; Calculate HI tax using 6.4% flat rate
Nexus but no taxable income - no tax liability

policy_statement.policy_description: Hawaii state corporate income tax calculation
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Hawaii state corporate income tax calculation: 1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28], 2. Apportioned to HI: x [Apportionment %], 3. State additions: + [Additions], 4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions], 5. HI taxable income: = [Result], 6. HI tax rate: x 6.4%, 7. HI income tax: = [Tax before credits], 8. HI credits: - [Credits], 9. HI tax liability: = [Final tax]. Reference: Hawaii Form N-30 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions, Hawaii Department of Taxation Corporate Income Tax Guide, HI Rev. Stat. § 235-71 (Tax rate: 6.4%)"

policy_statement.policy_description: No Hawaii nexus - no tax liability.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No Hawaii nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded."

policy_statement.policy_description: No Hawaii taxable income - no tax liability.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No Hawaii taxable income - no tax liability. Hawaii NOL rules may apply (not implemented)."
